label: TS-453D 4-bay NAS
description: 4-bay desktop NAS with two 2.5GbE RJ45 ports and a single PCIe Gen2 x2 slot. A 10GbE card fits that slot but the x2 link caps its throughput.
notes: Onboard: 2x 2.5GbE RJ45. PCIe Gen2 x2 slot - QNAP warns the x2 bandwidth limits 10GbE performance. No management port.
